import sys
def input():
    return sys.stdin.readline().rstrip()

INF = 10000000
def dijkstra(road, start):
    dp = [INF]*(n+1)
    dp[start] = 0
    heap = []
    heappush(heap, [0, start])

    while heap:
        cur_time, cur = heappop(heap)

        if cur_time > dp[cur]: #기존 경로 사용
            continue

        for t, nxt in road[cur]:
            new_time = t + cur_time
            if new_time < dp[nxt]:
                dp[nxt] = new_time
                heappush(heap, [new_time, nxt])
    return dp
